In the Quran, the concept of 'jabr' or predestination is emphasized, which means that God Almighty has already ordained the destinies of all His creations. By embracing the name Neeknaz, its bearer is reminded of the spiritual significance of perseverance, determination, and striving for excellence in all his endeavors, with trust and reliance on Allah's will.
